design_note: The TRAP. Looks excellent on paper (values, timeline, spark all align). But one partner has a concealed pattern: avoidant, unwilling to grow, and the other quietly over-functions to compensate. Per human label: conditional leaning NO, because trust & safety are foundational and a hidden character/growth asymmetry undermines them. Tests whether the system can see PAST surface compatibility to the character/safety gate — and whether grace-biased agents get fooled (the calibration danger).

person_a.name: Noah
person_a.summary: Charming, successful, says all the right things; aligned on values, faith, timeline. BUT consistently avoidant: withholds, deflects accountability, and has not disclosed a pattern of emotional unavailability that past partners named.

values.family: Says he wants kids on her timeline.

emotional_profile.maturity: Presents as high, but UNDISCLOSED pattern: avoids vulnerability, rarely takes accountability, withdraws when truly challenged; minimizes feedback.
emotional_profile.growth_orientation: Low and hidden — talks growth, does not do the work; deflects when invited deeper.

person_a.life_stage: Says ready; presentation may outrun reality.
person_a.trust_safety_note: Pattern is concealed; partner cannot make an informed choice. Trust/safety foundation is compromised by non-disclosure.

person_b.name: Grace
person_b.summary: Warm, capable, emotionally mature — and prone to OVER-FUNCTIONING: she compensates for partners' gaps and explains away red flags. Aligned with Noah on paper.

emotional_profile.maturity: High individually, BUT over-functions and self-silences to keep peace; tends to absorb the relational load.
emotional_profile.attachment_style: Secure-leaning but anxious in this dynamic.
emotional_profile.growth_orientation: High for herself; risk is she shoulders the couple's growth alone.

person_b.life_stage: Ready; at risk of committing before the pattern surfaces.
dealbreakers: Dishonesty (if she could see it clearly)
person_b.trust_safety_note: Her over-functioning masks his withdrawal, delaying the surfacing of a trust/safety problem.
